bioconda.name: alnstats
bioconda.summary: A high-performance command-line tool designed to calculate yield and duplicate statistics from BAM, SAM, or CRAM alignment files

build.script:
cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
cargo install -v --locked --no-track --path . --root $PREFIX
rm -rf $CARGO_HOME $RUSTUP_HOME
